svg.text: U3 · Review and approve the extracted values
Every value is checked against the masked page before it is used (ADR-0006); vectors are written on approval (ADR-0008). Alternatives are alt frames (success
path in green); red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
Review (user): are the values the AI extracted correct? · no SLA: waits for a person
The masking was approved in the browser before the upload.
Here the user checks only the extracted values against the masked pages.
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start
2. SELECT Version, LabResult[] WHERE userId=@me AND verId AND status=PendingReview; SELECT Alias (shared) for the printed names
3. per row: suggest a parameter (1 alias, 2 ICD-9 PL code, 3 similar known name, 4 the model's suggestion from extraction); compute the flag if the lab printed none
4. { rowVersion, results[] + pageSha + bbox + suggestion { parameter, source } + condition + flags (lab, computed) }
8. "This document was deleted", back to the list
13. show values without highlighting (the review still works)
15. unzip (JSZip); each value next to its place on the page; the user corrects values or rejects rows
16. per new printed name: confirm or change the parameter; set the measurement condition (fasting, after a load, …) with one click
17. lab flag ≠ computed flag: shown in red (often an extraction error)
18. "Nothing to approve": delete the document (U8) or reprocess it (U9); the approve button stays off
Browser closed during review: corrections are lost,
status stays PendingReview, the user starts the review again.
19. POST /documents/{docId}/versions/{verId}/approve { rowVersion, corrections[], rejected[], mappings[]: { name, material, condition, parameter } }
✗ network error: still PendingReview, UI retries (rowVersion makes a repeat harmless)
20. GET text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json (fragments: comments and descriptions, never result rows)
✗ OpenAI down: 503, nothing written; still PendingReview, UI retries

23. TX: UPDATE Version SET Approved WHERE verId AND status=PendingReview AND rowVersion=@rv; if 1 row: apply corrections, DELETE rejected rows, set parameter + condition, normalised value and computed flag (code, conversion table version), INSERT Alias (shared) if new, SET Archived on the previous Approved version, INSERT Fragment(text, vector)[]; COMMIT
✗ response lost: approved anyway; the UI shows it on refresh
26. already Approved: show it; otherwise reload the review (corrections kept in the form)
[0 rows: approved already (a retry), or rowVersion changed (new extraction, another tab)]
[ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
Approval sends no message, so there is no outbox and no gap here. Fragments and vectors are written in the same
transaction: no indexing stage. One Approved version per document; the previous one becomes Archived.
plaintext original or unmasked personal data
note: a fact, e.g. the user closes the browser
✗ if this step fails: state of the system
